name: Create Image
summary: Text to image with FLUX 3 Image Klein: aspect ratio, 1K to 2K, a photographic look, and a 9B upsampler that can expand your prompt.

source.notes: The same distilled Klein file as apps/edit. The template's bounding-box tool is left out: a layout table can be typed at the end of the prompt as the JSON that Flux3LayoutPrompt writes, [{"id": "obj_1", "bbox": [y0, x0, y1, x1], "desc": "..."}] with coordinates from 0 to 1000 (turn the upsampler off for it).

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: A rainy neon street in Mexico City at night, cinematic, 35mm

inputs.label: Expand my prompt
inputs.help: BFL's 9B upsampler rewrites a short prompt into a detailed caption before Klein draws it. Turn it off for long prompts or a JSON layout.

inputs.label: Look
inputs.help: A photographic look added after your prompt (like a moodboard preset).

options.value: Shot on a cheap disposable film camera with its built-in flash: harsh flash, slight vignette, film grain, a warm color cast.
options.label: Disposable camera

options.value: A fashion editorial photo lit by direct flash: crisp hard shadow behind the subject, glossy highlights, high contrast.
options.label: Flash editorial

options.value: A black-and-white film photo: rich grain, deep blacks, soft highlights.
options.label: Black and white film

options.value: A color film photo with warm, saturated colors and soft grain.

options.value: A color film photo with muted, cool tones, low contrast and fine grain.

options.value: A soft pastel color film photo: lifted shadows, gentle light, low saturation.

options.value: A Y2K studio portrait: glossy chrome and pastel backdrop, soft flash, early-2000s styling.
options.label: Y2K studio

inputs.label: Aspect ratio
inputs.help: At 1K the image has about 1 megapixel in this shape; Resolution scales it.

inputs.label: Resolution
inputs.help: 1K is about 1 megapixel; 2K is four times the pixels and takes about four times as long.
